'''Helium grenades''' were a type of [[Grenade/Legends|grenades]] available in the period following the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]] between the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] and the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]]. They were efficient against [[Mynock/Legends|mynocks]].
